newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PX50 SLIPS BACK AT FIXING.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PX50 SLIPS BACK AT FIXING.

text.p: Czech shares fell back at Tuesday's price fixing on the Prague bourse led by major issues with gains in the broader market not strong enough to prevent the PX50 from moving lower.
Power utility CEZ, returned to trading after a week off market prior to the company's annual general meeting on Thursday. CEZ dropped six crowns to 895.
The construction sector was generally lower. Metrostav dropped 24 crowns to 2,126, IPS Praha fell one crown to 209 and Vodni Stavby Praha lost 45 crowns to 910.
Dealers and analysts say the sector is beset by problems on all sides as overcapacity within the industry combines with a downturn in the economy as a whole.
So I've just put my recommendations to hold or sell," said Anna Bossong of ING barings.
